Original signed BSG 9.7 V32 as a system app, with the verified native cache fix.
Historical Android 16 GSI evidence only; no new device validation during
reorganization. The recommended XML is the owner-provided V32 profile (755 preferences), imported manually. V32 and telephoto OIS were tested and work correctly on Android 16 GSI. Any compatible external GCam can also be installed without this system module.
RAW, OIS and flash are maintained separately:
https://github.com/SRE-0/infinix_x6810_raw

English documentation with linked Spanish editions. Experimental software provided as-is; responsibility is excluded only to the extent permitted by law. Read DISCLAIMER.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
